significance: The festival of lights and the Lakshmi puja. Lakshmi visits homes that are clean, lit and welcoming; the puja is done in the pradosh window after sunset.

rule_basis: amanta Ashwin Krishna Chaturdashi (purnimanta Kartika) at sunrise
significance: Krishna killed Narakasura before dawn. An oil bath is taken at sunrise and a single diya is lit at the doorway before nightfall.

rule_basis: Kartika Shukla Pratipada at sunrise (udaya, Drik Panchang convention; Vidhata convention); a kshaya pratipada goes to the day it runs
year_note: Kartika Shukla Pratipada; kshaya (begins after this sunrise, ends before the next), so the one day it runs
significance: Krishna lifted the Govardhan hill to shelter Vrindavan. The annakut is made, a small mountain of cooked food offered and then shared with the whole house.

rule_basis: Kartika Shukla Dwitiya at sunrise, which is also the aparahna the tilak needs
significance: Yamuna fed her brother Yama. The sister applies tilak on the brother's forehead and the meal she serves is remembered through the year.

rule_basis: Kartika Shukla Shashthi present at sunset, when the sandhya arghya is offered
year_note: Kartika Shukla Shashthi, sandhya arghya at sunset
significance: The four-day Surya vrat of the Bhojpuri belt, peaking with the sunset and sunrise arghya to the Sun standing in the river. One of the hardest vrats kept.

rule_basis: Kartika Shukla Dwadashi at sunrise, the day after Prabodhini Ekadashi
year_note: Kartika Shukla Dwadashi, sunrise; the day after Prabodhini Ekadashi
significance: The ceremonial marriage of the tulsi plant to Vishnu that opens the wedding season. The courtyard tulsi is dressed as a bride at dusk.

rule_basis: Kartika Purnima at sunrise
significance: The full moon that closes the Kartik vrat month. Varanasi lights the ghats for Dev Deepawali; it is also Guru Nanak Jayanti.

rule_basis: Margashirsha Shukla Ekadashi (Mokshada Ekadashi) at sunrise
significance: The day Krishna spoke the Bhagavad Gita to Arjuna on the field of Kurukshetra. A chapter is read and the text is honoured on the home altar.

rule_basis: Margashirsha Purnima present at pradosh; in 2026 that Purnima never touches a sunrise
significance: The birth of Dattatreya, the union of Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva. The Margashira full-moon evening is given to his worship and the reading of his charitra.

rule_basis: Bhadrapada Shukla Tritiya present during pratahkala
year_note: Bhadrapada Shukla Tritiya 2028 runs 08:44 IST 22 Aug to 05:10 IST 23 Aug at Ujjain and touches neither a pratahkala nor a sunrise (kshaya). The nirnaya has not been ruled on, so no date is published rather than a guessed one.
significance: Parvati's vrat to win Shiva, kept by married women without food or water. A sand lingam is made and the night is spent in worship.
